Description

This video presents the prediction results of our bio-LSTM network. We first show the motivation and challenges of the pose prediction problem for urban pedestrians and we illustrate the biomechanical constraints on human poses. Then, we show 3D rendered animation results of predicted pedestrian body poses on the PedX dataset, a large-scale, in-the-wild pedestrian dataset collected at real urban intersections in Ann Arbor, MI, USA. We present example results for both next-frame prediction and multiple timestep prediction (longer time horizon). Additionally, we show prediction examples of pedestrian actions in the scene.
Review our Supplemental Items documentation for more information.
